# P1 Land & Property Management

> Full-service land and property management for commercial, agricultural, industrial, equestrian, and large residential properties 1 acre and larger. Serving Upstate South Carolina and the greater Charlotte, North Carolina region.

P1 Land & Property Management is a Carolinas-based land management contractor. One contractor for the entire life of your land — from initial clearing and reconstruction through ongoing weekly and seasonal care.

- Phone: +1 (704) 221-8928
- Email: info@p1landmanagement.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 7 AM–6 PM, Saturday by appointment, Sunday closed
- Minimum property size: 1 acre
- Free estimates: https://www.p1landmanagement.com/contact

## Services

- [Commercial Property Management](https://www.p1landmanagement.com/services/commercial-property-management): Year-round grounds maintenance contracts for commercial sites, HOAs, and facilities
- [Industrial & Agricultural](https://www.p1landmanagement.com/services/industrial-agricultural): Land maintenance for industrial sites, farms, pasture, and working acreage
- [Land Clearing](https://www.p1landmanagement.com/services/land-clearing): Lot clearing, forestry mulching, right-of-way, and rural acreage
- [Grading & Site Preparation](https://www.p1landmanagement.com/services/grading-site-preparation): Fine grading and site prep for commercial and residential development
- [Drainage Solutions](https://www.p1landmanagement.com/services/drainage): French drains, retention, stormwater, and erosion control
- [Turf Installation & Seeding](https://www.p1landmanagement.com/services/turf-installation-seeding): Sod and large-acreage seeding for Piedmont soils
- [Tree Services](https://www.p1landmanagement.com/services/tree-services): Trimming, removal, and selective clearing
- [Pond & Waterway Management](https://www.p1landmanagement.com/services/pond-waterway-management): Pond construction, restoration, and water quality
- [Property Reconstruction](https://www.p1landmanagement.com/services/property-reconstruction): Complete rebuilds of neglected or storm-damaged properties
